PRE-EMPTIVE REMEDIATION before this ticket's first plan review.

1. FILE_IMPACT WAS EMPTY — set now (5 paths). An unscoped attestation dies stale-head on EVERY commit, and setting file_impact AFTER a review is a material edit that destroys the PASS. Before, not after.

2. AC4's PREMISE WAS STALE ON TWO COUNTS, both verified against the shipped gates/code-review.yaml rather than assumed. It said the gate takes cfg.model 'for all four passes'. The gate has THREE prompt steps — base, verify, coach — and `verify` ALREADY declares `model: standard`, landed by sibling 172e. So as written the AC was unsatisfiable (there is no fourth pass to fix) and it concealed that a third of the work is already done. Corrected to name the two steps that genuinely still inherit cfg.model: base (Pass-1) and coach (Pass-4).

AC5 was already correctly tagged [operator-attested] — a live gate run's usage log is not a repository artifact. Left as is.
